query: SK Hynix ADR Nasdaq listing SKHY first trading date July 2026 latest news, pricing date, roadshow status, SEC review as of late June 2026. Is July 10 still the expected trading date? Any reports of delay or schedule slippage?
answer:
## Summary

The research question is now **resolved by events** — as of today (2026-07-27), the SK Hynix Nasdaq ADR listing is **complete and happened exactly on schedule, with no delay**.

**Key findings:**
- **July 10 held.** SK Hynix debuted on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on **Friday, July 10, 2026**, the originally expected (though officially "tentative") date. There was **no schedule slippage**.
- **Pricing date:** Thursday, **July 9, 2026** — priced at **$149.00 per ADS**.
- **Ticker sequence:** Traded "when-issued" as **SKHYV** on July 10, then switched to permanent ticker **SKHY** for regular-way trading on **Monday, July 13, 2026** (settlement July 14).
- **Size/record:** 177.9 million ADS raising **~$26.51 billion** — the **largest ADS/ADR offering in history**, surpassing Alibaba's $25B 2014 IPO.
- **Demand:** At least **~7x oversubscribed**; cornerstone investors (Baillie Gifford, Coatue, Situational Awareness Partners) indicated up to $7B. Underwriters: BofA, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan.
- **Day-one performance:** Opened ~$170, closed **$168.01 (+~13%)**.
- **SEC review:** Progressed from a confidential filing to a public F-1/A with **no reported delays**; the roadshow completed and priced on time.

The premise's concern about a possible July 10 delay never materialized — the deal executed cleanly on the anticipated timeline.
